SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Alameda' AND s.StatusType = 'Merged' AND f.NumTstTakr < 100;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.StatusType = 'Merged'

  AND s.District = 'Alameda County Office of Education'
  AND f.NumTstTakr < 100;
